scope: Theorem 7.1 of the manuscript “Randomized quasipolynomial-time mean-payoff games” (preprints/Randomized-quasipolynomial-time-mean-payoff-games-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 104 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4ab7552f58266134), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 32. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The algorithm has a uniform implementation in a standard bit-operation model such that, for every input of bit length L and every random tape, the running time is at most 2C(log2(L+2))2 for an absolute constant C > 0. The bound includes preprocessing, every recursive execution, intermediate arithmetic, and random-bit generation.
